C-unreachable from do_users: CON_IDCONED is assigned only at src/ident.c:107 (ident_start via new_descriptor at src/comm.c:563-564) and src/ident.c:145 (falling through to case CON_IDCONED: at :147). In game_loop, ident_check (src/comm.c:585-590) always runs before command_interpreter (:594-628), and case CON_IDCONED: (:147-161) unconditionally overwrites STATE(d) to CON_ASKNAME (:157) or CON_IDREADING (:161). No path exits ident_check in state 23. (R1/R2/R5e/R5g)

C-unreachable from do_users: CON_IDREAD is assigned only at src/ident.c:181, which falls through to case CON_IDREAD: (:183). That case has no early break/return, unconditionally sets STATE(d) = CON_ASKNAME (:220), and falls through to case CON_ASKNAME: (:222), which closes the socket (:236) or sets CON_GET_NAME and returns (:241-242). No path exits ident_check in state 25. (R1/R2/R5e/R5g)
